suggest: 開催予定
summary: "Upcoming" (an upcoming match) is translated as 近日公開, which means an upcoming release/publication, not an upcoming match.

current: ワールドカップ開催についての最新情報をお伝えします
rationale: The source states updates will be provided as the World Cup approaches; the Japanese drops the temporal "approaches" sense.
suggest: ワールドカップ開催が近づくにつれて最新情報をお伝えします
summary: "as the World Cup approaches" is rendered as "about the World Cup being held", losing the meaning of the approaching event.

current: 指紋認証を利用してログインする。
rationale: The source means using Touch ID to access the stored Logins list, not to sign in; the Japanese reverses the object of the action.
string_id: Use your fingerprint to access Logins now.
suggest: 指紋認証を利用してログイン情報にアクセスします。
summary: Translation says "log in using fingerprint" instead of "use your fingerprint to access saved Logins".

current: 環境設定を開く
rationale: The developer comment says this opens the iOS system settings; iOS's Settings app is called 設定 in Japanese, and the related string DefaultBrowserOnboarding.Screenshot refers to the iOS settings page. 環境設定 names a different thing and is inconsistent with the platform term.
suggest: 設定を開く
summary: "Go to Settings" refers to the iOS Settings app, rendered as 環境設定 (Preferences) instead of 設定.

current: 1. 環境設定を開く
rationale: This step instructs the user to open the iOS Settings app, which is named 設定 in Japanese; 環境設定 (Preferences) points at a different thing and conflicts with the following steps describing the iOS settings screen.
suggest: 1. 設定を開く
summary: Step 1 "Go to Settings" uses 環境設定 instead of the iOS Settings app name 設定.

current: ページ内で次を検索
rationale: The source names a result ("Next in-page result"), not an action of searching; the Japanese turns the noun label into a search command.
suggest: ページ内の次の検索結果
summary: Accessibility label translated as "search for next in page" instead of "next in-page result".

current: ページ内で前を検索
rationale: The source names a result ("Previous in-page result"), not a search action; the Japanese changes the meaning of the accessibility label.
suggest: ページ内の前の検索結果
summary: Accessibility label translated as "search for previous in page" instead of "previous in-page result".

current: 他の端末から同期されたものを含む
rationale: The source specifies "synced history from other devices"; the Japanese drops 履歴 leaving a vague "もの".
suggest: 他の端末から同期された履歴を含む
summary: "synced history from other devices" is rendered as "synced from other devices" without specifying history, but more importantly no defect—see rationale.

current: 環境設定を開く
rationale: Other strings in the same batch translate "settings" as 設定 (e.g. ContextualHints.TabTray.InactiveTabs.CallToAction "設定でオフにする", ContextualHints.SearchBarPlacement.CallToAction "ツールバー設定"); 環境設定 is the desktop Preferences term and is inconsistent on iOS.
suggest: 設定を開く
summary: "Go to Settings" is rendered as 環境設定 (Preferences) instead of the iOS-standard 設定 used elsewhere in this file.

current: 先へ進む場合は、潜在的な危険性があることに注意してください。
rationale: The source makes proceeding conditional on the user accepting the risk; the translation merely asks them to be aware of it.
suggest: 潜在的な危険性を承知の上で先へ進んでください。
summary: "Proceed if you accept the potential risk" is weakened to "be aware there is a potential risk if you proceed".

current: この接続は安全ではありません
rationale: The source says the connection is untrusted (certificate trust), not that it is insecure; Firefox uses distinct strings for "not secure".
suggest: この接続は信頼されていません
summary: "This Connection is Untrusted" is rendered as "this connection is not secure", changing the meaning from trust to security.

current: より詳しく
rationale: The button navigates to more Pocket stories, not to more detail about the current item; 「より詳しく」 means "in greater detail".
suggest: もっと見つける
summary: "Discover more" (see more stories) is translated as "より詳しく" (in more detail).

current: 最短: %d 分
rationale: Per the developer comment, "min" is the abbreviation of minutes to read an article, not "minimum"; the translation states a minimum duration instead.
suggest: %d 分
summary: "min: %d" (minutes to read) is translated as "最短: %d 分" ("minimum: %d minutes").

current: Firefox Sync が %@ に接続しました
rationale: en-US "Firefox Sync has connected to %@" with the comment stating another device has connected to FxA; Japanese particle usage reverses the subject/target relation relative to the intended meaning of a newly connected device.
suggest: %@ が Firefox Sync に接続しました
summary: Direction of connection is reversed: the source says another device connected to Sync, but the target says Sync connected to the device.

current: 表示履歴
rationale: Source is simply "History" (sync toggle); HistoryPanel.HistoryBackButton.Title translates the same term as 履歴, creating inconsistency.
suggest: 履歴
summary: "History" is translated as 表示履歴 while the other History strings in the same file use 履歴.

current: 最近の履歴を消去...
rationale: The en-US string ends with the ellipsis character "…"; the Japanese uses "...".
suggest: 最近の履歴を消去…
summary: Uses three ASCII periods instead of the ellipsis character used in the source.

current: 1 時間以内
rationale: The source labels the time range "The Last Hour"; the standard Firefox Japanese wording is 過去 1 時間.
suggest: 過去 1 時間
summary: "The Last Hour" is rendered as "1 時間以内" (within 1 hour) rather than the past hour period label.

current: 休止中のタブをすべて閉じます
rationale: The developer comment says this is a button the user taps; "Close All Inactive Tabs" should be an imperative/noun-style button label, not the polite declarative "閉じます" (other button labels in this batch, e.g. Close Tab "タブを閉じる", use the plain form).
suggest: 休止中のタブをすべて閉じる
summary: Button label is translated as a polite sentence rather than a button action label.

current: 今回はしない
rationale: The source says "Don’t Save"; the paired button LoginsHelper.DontUpdate.Button correctly uses 更新しない, so the save button should be 保存しない rather than "not this time".
suggest: 保存しない
summary: "Don’t Save" is rendered as "今回はしない" ("Not this time"), which changes the meaning.

current: 検索条件に一致するログイン情報はありません。
rationale: en-US: "There are no results matching your search." The Japanese adds "ログイン情報" (logins) which is not in the source.
suggest: 検索条件に一致する結果はありません。
summary: Translation says "no logins matching" whereas the source says "no results matching your search".

current: 環境設定を開く
rationale: On iOS the system app and Firefox's own Settings screen are called 設定; 環境設定 is the macOS/desktop term and is inconsistent with the source term "Settings".
suggest: 設定を開く
summary: "Open Settings" is rendered as 「環境設定を開く」 (Preferences), while iOS Japanese uses 設定 for Settings.

current: これは、画像を Camera Roll に保存することを許可します。
rationale: The en-US "This allows you to save the image to your Camera Roll" addresses the user's ability; the Japanese literal 「〜を許可します」 makes the app the grantor, and Camera Roll is localized as カメラロール on iOS Japanese.
suggest: これにより、画像をカメラロールに保存できるようになります。
summary: The translation says the permission "allows saving" in an awkward reversed framing and leaves "Camera Roll" untranslated.

current: ご協力いただだける方は
rationale: Duplicated character "だ" — spelling error in the Japanese text.
string_id: Send a crash report so Mozilla can fix the problem?
suggest: ご協力いただける方は
summary: Typo: "いただだける" should be "いただける".

current: 環境設定からログイン
rationale: The en-US source says "go to Settings"; on iOS the app's Settings is 設定 (as used in ScanQRCode.PermissionError.Message.v100 and the Search settings string). 環境設定 is the desktop Preferences term.
suggest: 設定からログイン
summary: "Settings" rendered as 環境設定 instead of 設定, inconsistent with other strings in the same file.

current: 最近保存したサイト
rationale: The section covers saved bookmarks/reading list items, not sites; the source has no "sites" qualifier.
suggest: 最近保存したページ
summary: "Recently Saved" is translated as "最近保存したサイト" (recently saved sites), adding "sites" not in the source.

current: %@ の定番
rationale: The source is the title of the always-available wallpaper collection, "Classic Firefox"; 定番 changes the meaning to "staple/standard item of Firefox".
suggest: クラシック %@
summary: "Classic %@" is rendered as "%@ の定番" which reads "the standard/staple of %@" rather than the wallpaper collection name "Classic Firefox".

current: オープニング画面
rationale: Settings.Home.Option.StartAtHome.Title translates the identical source term "Opening screen" as 最初の画面; using a different term on the same settings area is inconsistent.
suggest: 最初の画面
summary: "OPENING SCREEN" is translated as "オープニング画面" while the same concept is rendered "最初の画面" elsewhere in the same settings screen group.

current: 指紋認証を使用してログイン情報とパスワードにアクセスします。
rationale: The en-US source is "Use your fingerprint to access passwords now." — there is no mention of logins; the screen was renamed to Passwords only.
suggest: 指紋認証を使用してパスワードにアクセスします。
summary: Translation says "logins and passwords" while the source only says "passwords".

current: ログアウトしています...
rationale: The en-US source uses the single-character ellipsis "…"; Japanese typography also expects …
suggest: ログアウトしています…
summary: ASCII three dots used instead of the ellipsis character present in the source.

current: アドレスバー内の盾アイコンをタップして
rationale: The source says to tap the lock in the address bar; 盾 means shield, naming the wrong UI element.
suggest: アドレスバー内の鍵アイコンをタップして
summary: "the lock" in the address bar is translated as "盾アイコン" (shield icon).

current: ユーザーの行動を追跡する広告を阻止します
rationale: Source: "helps stop advertisers from tracking your browsing" — the agent is the advertiser and the object is the tracking, not the ad itself.
suggest: 広告主がユーザーの閲覧行動を追跡するのを防ぎます
summary: The translation says it blocks ads that track users, whereas the source says it helps stop advertisers from tracking your browsing.

current: アドレスバー内の盾アイコンをタップして
rationale: The string id and source both specify the lock icon in the address bar; 盾 (shield) names a different icon.
suggest: アドレスバー内の鍵アイコンをタップして
summary: "the lock" is rendered as "盾アイコン" (shield icon) although this variant explicitly refers to the lock.

current: 一部のトラッカー広告を許可します
rationale: The source allows some ad tracking (the tracking activity), not certain ads.
suggest: 一部の広告トラッキングを許可します
summary: "some ad tracking" is translated as "一部のトラッカー広告" (some tracker ads).

current: 広範囲
rationale: The source term is Strict, the counterpart of Standard (標準); 広範囲 means "wide range" and does not render the term.
suggest: 厳格
summary: "Strict" is translated as "広範囲" (broad/wide range).

current: このページは %1$@ で表示されています。
rationale: en-US "This page appears to be in %1$@" expresses a guess about the page's language; the Japanese asserts it is being displayed in that language, losing the hedge and changing the meaning.
suggest: このページは %1$@ で書かれているようです。
summary: The first clause says the page "is displayed in %1$@" instead of "appears to be in %1$@".

current: 直前
rationale: The developer comment says this is a relative time for a tab visited within the last few moments; the standard Japanese rendering is たった今, whereas 直前 reads as "right before (something)".
suggest: たった今
summary: "just now" rendered as 直前, which means "immediately before" rather than the relative time "just now".

current: 全選択を解除
rationale: The source means deselect all logins; 全選択 refers to the select-all state, not to all selected items, and pairs poorly with すべて選択 for Select All.
suggest: すべての選択を解除
summary: "Deselect All" is rendered as 全選択を解除 ("cancel select-all") rather than deselecting all items.

current: 検索モードを入力してください
rationale: The developer comment says it is an accessibility label for entering search mode for logins; 「入力してください」 wrongly means "please type in the search mode".
suggest: 検索モードに入る
summary: "Enter Search Mode" (enter = switch into search mode) is translated as "input the search mode".

current: ページを共有...
rationale: The en-US source uses the single-character ellipsis “…” (Share Page With…); the translation substitutes three full stops.
suggest: ページを共有…
summary: Ellipsis rendered as three ASCII periods instead of the ellipsis character used in the source.

current: その他 %d 個...
rationale: The source “+%d More…” uses the single ellipsis character; the translation uses three periods.
suggest: その他 %d 個…
summary: Ellipsis rendered as three ASCII periods instead of the ellipsis character used in the source.

current: 最近よく訪れるサイトへのショートカットを追加します。
rationale: The source lists two separate categories of sites (frequently visited and recently visited); the translation merges them into "sites recently visited often", changing the meaning.
suggest: よく閲覧するサイトや最近閲覧したサイトへのショートカットを追加します。
summary: "frequently and recently visited sites" is rendered as a single notion "最近よく訪れるサイト", dropping the "frequently" and "recently" distinction.
